resolved_findings.issue: Held-out calibration acceptance does not reject profile diagnostic calibration
resolved_findings.mechanism: A profiled development artifact shares source_sha256, model identities and calibration_identity with unprofiled execution and has calibration_frozen=true. Held-out accepts it, but profile-suffixed curve keys do not match unprofiled lookup keys, causing JointBudget.choose to use default MTPVarlen rather than the measured curve.
resolved_findings.requested_fix: Validate calibration execution/profile mode and exact expected curve identities before loading weights; add CPU regression rejecting profiled or mixed-key calibration.
resolved_findings.resolution: validate_calibration now requires unprofiled execution identity, accepted frozen development, exact source/model/workload, complete unique B1/B2 CostKeys and all legal budget points with finite positive costs, before model load.

provenance_note: Actual Metal/profile verification occurred before this calibration-input guard fix.
